decisions.Kwic: 祖曰我心未寧乞師安心磨曰將心來與汝安祖曰覔心了不可得曰與汝安心竟祖於此悟入。

Decision.AttributionNote: Collected Pearls Linking Verses on Old Cases in the Chan Lineage (禪宗頌古聯珠通集), Bodhidharma–Huike mind-settling case. Huike asks that his unsettled mind be set at ease and says he cannot find it; Bodhidharma is the exact respondent who concludes, 'I have finished setting your mind at ease.' Huike is the requester and the person who awakens afterward, not the speaker of the closing headword-bearing response.

decisions.Kwic: 曰如何是法眼曰法眼無瑕

Decision.AttributionNote: Collected Pearls Linking Verses on Old Cases in the Chan Lineage (禪宗頌古聯珠通集), in the narrative leading Jiashan Shanhui to Chuanzi Decheng. An unnamed monk asks Jiashan what the Dharma eye is, and Jiashan Shanhui is the exact respondent who says that the Dharma eye has no flaw. The graphs 法眼 here name the eye of the teaching, not the later title-name Fayan Wenyi.
